final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), stats AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count) as avg_count FROM state_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.invoice_count, s.total_invoices, s.avg_count, CAST(sc.invoice_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_invoices as share FROM state_counts sc CROSS JOIN stats s), filtered AS (SELECT invoice_count, avg_count, share FROM with_shares WHERE invoice_count > avg_count) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices_in_filtered_groups, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(invoice_count - avg_count) as average_excess FROM filtered
